headline: Montclair State leads the NJAC with seventeen wins
dek: Montclair State has won seventeen matches across all competitions while drawing three and losing three, conceding only fifteen goals in the process. No other NJAC program has reached that win total, putting Montclair State clear at the top of the conference.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the NJAC splits sharply between the top half and the bottom, with Montclair State's 74 goals across all matches exceeding the combined totals of Kean, Stockton, Rutgers-Camden, and William Paterson.

wire.line: TCNJ has taken only one defeat all season, matching its nine wins with nine draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven scheduled NJAC matches have passed their dates without a published result, spanning August dates for New Paltz and November dates involving Rowan and Rutgers-Newark.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Montclair State forward Tomas Monteiro has scored nineteen goals and added nine assists on 55 shots, leading the NJAC's published scoring leaders.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: TCNJ goalkeeper Sean Najdzinowicz has recorded 60 saves against twelve goals allowed for a 0.833 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rowan has compiled fifteen wins, four draws, and two losses across all matches, scoring 46 goals while conceding sixteen.

last_match.line: Rowan had been unbeaten at home and against non-conference opponents all season before this defeat.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
